notes.title: v1.1.3 maintenance update
notes.notes:
Adjusted some labels on the Audio Mixer screen
Fixed a typo on the Audio Glossary screen
Updated the desktop application to Electron 17

notes.title: v1.1.1 hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello psychonauts!

The v1.1.1 update fixes a hard lock that occurred whenever instrument unlocks were spawned. This should solve reported issues with crashes and black screens. Thanks for understanding.

Cheers!
